name: @juxnow/tubular
description: Declare TypeScript agent tools once, then derive contracts, validation and MCP bindings.

scripts.check: npm run docs:check && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test && npm run example:check && npm run consumer:check
scripts.example: npm run build && tsc -p examples/hello/tsconfig.json && node dist/cli.js generate --project examples/hello/tsconfig.json --entry tools.ts --out examples/hello/schemas.json && node examples/hello/run.mjs
scripts.example:generate: node dist/cli.js generate --project examples/governed/tsconfig.json --entry tools.ts --out examples/governed/schemas.json --bindings examples/governed/bindings.ts
scripts.example:governed: npm run build && npm run example:generate && tsc -p examples/governed/tsconfig.build.json && node examples/governed/build/run.js
scripts.example:check: node dist/cli.js generate --project examples/hello/tsconfig.json --entry tools.ts --out examples/hello/schemas.json --check && node dist/cli.js generate --project examples/governed/tsconfig.json --entry tools.ts --out examples/governed/schemas.json --bindings examples/governed/bindings.ts --check && tsc -p examples/governed/tsconfig.build.json && node examples/governed/build/run.js
